
# Tables and Figures {#sec-sm-tables-figures}

```{r}
#| label: setup-supp-tables-figures
#| include: false

# Figures/tables are computed by the analysis stage (scripts/peri_op_med_analysis.qmd and
# scripts/peri_op_med_supp_mat.qmd) and saved to export/*.rds. Each labelled chunk below prints
# one of them with show_float(), which also saves a copy named after the label into export/.
source(here::here("scripts", "export_helpers.R"))
main <- load_objects("main")   # stbl-demo-adult and stbl-outcome-adult come from the main store
supp <- load_objects("supp")
```


## Supplementary Tables

::: {#stbl-demo-adult}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-stbl-demo-adult

# The saved object is still named tbl_demo_adult (in the main store)
show_float(main, key = "tbl_demo_adult")
```

**Demographics table - Adult patients.** Participant and surgical data for adult cohort stratified by surgical procedure group. Categorical data as number (%). IQR (Interquartile Range), EPR (Electronic Patient Record).
:::

::: {#stbl-demo-paed}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-stbl-demo-paed

show_float(supp)
```

**Demographics table - Paediatric patients.** Participant and surgical data for paediatric cohort stratified by surgical procedure group. Categorical data as number (%). IQR (Interquartile Range), EPR (Electronic Patient Record).
:::

::: {#stbl-analgesic-paed}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-stbl-analgesic-paed

show_float(supp)
```

**Anaesthetic management - Paediatrics.** Intraoperative analgesia administration for paediatric patients stratified by surgical group. OME, Oral Morphine Equivalent. Weight-based dosed calculated were calculated where patient weight available. Treatment group shown as percentage of all patients who received complete simple analgesia.
:::

::: {#stbl-outcome-adult}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-stbl-outcome-adult

# The saved object is still named tbl_outcome_adult (in the main store)
show_float(main, key = "tbl_outcome_adult")
```

**Adult outcomes.** Outcome data for adult patients stratified by surgical group. Return to theatre at UCLH and representation to UCLH emergency department only, cumulative measures at each time point. Eligible medications for discharge measured as classified in @sec-sm-data-spec-discharge.
:::

::: {#stbl-outcome-paed}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-stbl-outcome-paed

show_float(supp)
```

**Paediatric outcomes.** Outcome data for paediatric patients stratified by surgical group. Return to theatre at UCLH and representation to UCLH emergency department only, cumulative measures at each time point. Eligible medications for discharge measured as classified in @sec-sm-data-spec-discharge.
:::

## Supplementary Figures

::: {#sfig-venn-paed}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-sfig-venn-paed
#| fig-alt: "Venn diagrams of paediatric intraoperative medications"
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 12

show_float(supp, width = 12, height = 8, scale = 1.5)
```

**Venn diagrams of paediatric intraoperative medications.** Distributions of complete intraoperative simple analgesia and intraoperative opioid administration in paediatrics (A). Venn diagram to show the breakdown of the simple analgesia (B) and opioids given (C).
:::

::: {#sfig-venn-paracetamol}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-sfig-venn-paracetamol
#| fig-alt: "Venn diagram of paracetamol administration"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

show_float(supp, width = 6, height = 4, scale = 2)
```

**Venn diagram of paracetamol administration.** Venn diagram of distributions of paracetamol given intraoperatively as defined as being given on the intraoperative medication administration record compared to doses of paracetamol given in the 3 hours pre-operatively for the adult cohort (A) and paediatric cohorts (B) respectively.
:::

::: {#sfig-venn-adjuncts}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-sfig-venn-adjuncts
#| fig-alt: "Venn diagram of analgesia adjuncts administration"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

show_float(supp, width = 6, height = 4, scale = 2)
```

**Venn diagram of analgesia adjuncts administration.** Distributions of magnesium, ketamine and clonidine given intraoperatively for the adult cohort (A) and paediatric cohorts (B) respectively.
:::

::: {#sfig-opioid-histogram-adult}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-sfig-opioid-histogram-adult
#| fig-alt: "Distribution of adult intraoperative opioid dose"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

show_float(supp, width = 10, height = 5, scale = 1)
```

**Distribution of adult intraoperative opioid dose.** Histogram with marginal rug plot of individual doses of total intraoperative OME doses across adult patients in treatment groups 2,3 and 4.
:::

::: {#sfig-opioid-histogram-paed}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-sfig-opioid-histogram-paed
#| fig-alt: "Distribution of paediatric intraoperative opioid dose"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

show_float(supp, width = 10, height = 5, scale = 1)
```

**Distribution of paediatric intraoperative opioid dose.** Histogram with marginal rug plot of individual doses of total intraoperative OME doses across paediatric patients in treatment groups 2,3 and 4.
:::

::: {#sfig-upset-paed}
```{r}
#| label: chunk-sfig-upset-paed
#| fig-alt: "Combinations of paediatric intraoperative analgesia"

show_float(supp)
```

**Combinations of paediatric intraoperative analgesia.** Distribution of different analgesic combinations for paediatric patients. Upper vertical bar graph showing the total count of each combination of analgesia with treatment groups coloured. Lower left horizontal bar graph showing the total count of patients receiving each specific medication. Bars coloured according to the treatment group: Group 1 - Blue, Group 2 - Yellow, Group 3 - Purple, Group 4 - Green.
:::
